    import sys

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    k = int(input[1])
    powers = [[int(input[i * k + j + 2]) for j in range(k)] for i in range(n)]

    output = []
    for i in range(n):
        max_powers = [max(p[j] for p in powers[:i+1]) for j in range(k)]
        winners = sum(all(p[j] >= max_powers[j] for j in range(k)) for p in powers[:i+1])
        output.append(winners)

    print(' '.join(map(str, output)))

main()
